cards.front: Benzodiazepines are avoided in PTSD because they impair [___] learning, which is essential for trauma-focused therapy.
cards.context:
Benzodiazepines impair memory consolidation in the amygdala, preventing new safety learning from consolidating.

They also worsen PTSD outcomes overall and carry high dependence risk.

cards.front: Among the psychotherapies, CBT is recommended first-line because it has the broadest [___] base of any psychotherapy.
cards.context: Its breadth of evidence is why Australian guidelines name it first-line for mild-moderate depression, anxiety and eating disorders.
